title: Food Menu
description: Proper British pub food at The Anchor — cooked fresh to order and served with a warm welcome.

categories.title: British Pub Classics
categories.description: Proper British pub favourites, full of comfort and flavour.

items.name: Fish & Chips
items.description: Golden beer-battered fish with chunky chips, mushy peas, tartare sauce and a wedge of lemon — a proper British classic.

items.name: Half Fish & Chips
items.description: All the flavour of our fish supper in a lighter portion — chunky chips, mushy peas, tartare sauce and lemon.

items.name: Scampi & Chips
items.description: Crispy golden scampi with chunky chips, mushy peas, tartare sauce and lemon — simple, satisfying and full of flavour.

items.name: Jumbo Sausage & Chips
items.description: A proper jumbo sausage with chunky chips, mushy peas and your choice of sauce — honest pub grub at its best.

items.name: Bangers & Mash
items.description: Three sausages on creamy mash with crispy onions and rich onion gravy — a timeless pub classic.

categories.title: Traditional British Pies
categories.description: Golden pastry, rich fillings and proper pub comfort. All pies are served with creamy mash and seasonal veg — swap your mash for chips if you prefer.

items.name: Beef & Ale Pie
items.description: Slow-cooked beef in a rich ale gravy, sealed in golden pastry — proper pub comfort on a plate.

items.name: Chicken & Wild Mushroom Pie
items.description: Tender chicken and earthy wild mushrooms in a creamy sauce, baked in flaky pastry until golden.

items.name: Chicken, Ham Hock & Leek Pie
items.description: Chicken, slow-cooked ham hock and tender leeks in a rich creamy sauce, wrapped in crisp golden pastry.

items.name: Butternut Squash, Mixed Bean & Mature Cheddar Pie
items.description: Butternut squash, mixed beans and mature cheddar in a gently spiced tomato sauce, baked in crisp pastry.

categories.title: House Burgers
categories.description: Straightforward burgers, proper portions and easy extras. All burgers are served with chips, salad and your choice of sauce.

items.name: Classic Beef Burger
items.description: A proper beef burger, simply done and easy to love — served with chips, salad and your choice of sauce.

items.name: Chicken Burger
items.description: Breaded chicken fillet with salad and your choice of sauce — a crowd-pleaser done properly.

items.name: Spicy Chicken Burger
items.description: Crispy spicy chicken with salad and your choice of sauce — for those who like a bit of fire.

items.name: Katsu Chicken Burger
items.description: Breaded chicken fillet topped with fragrant katsu curry sauce and fresh cucumber — a proper crowd favourite.

items.name: Garden Veg Burger
items.description: A hearty veggie patty with salad and your choice of sauce — satisfying and full of flavour.

categories.title: Comfort Favourites
categories.description: Warm, satisfying dishes for when you want something hearty.

items.name: Lasagne
items.description: Rich beef lasagne baked until golden, served with salad and garlic bread — the kind of dish that feels like home.

items.name: Mac & Cheese
items.description: Creamy macaroni cheese topped with crispy onions, served with salad and garlic bread — pure comfort in a bowl.

items.name: Spinach & Ricotta Cannelloni
items.description: Spinach and ricotta cannelloni baked in tomato sauce, served with salad and garlic bread — warm, satisfying and homely.

items.name: Chicken Katsu Curry
items.description: Crispy breaded chicken on fluffy rice with aromatic katsu curry sauce — a pub favourite with a twist.

categories.title: Stone-Baked Pizza
categories.description: Stone-baked to order with crisp bases and generous toppings. 12-inch gluten-free bases available on request.

sections.title: Pizza Selection
sections.description: Stone-baked to order on hand-stretched bases. All 12-inch pizzas are available with a gluten-free base on request — just ask when ordering.

items.name: Rustic Classic
items.description: Rich tomato sauce, creamy mozzarella, crisp stone-baked crust — a timeless favourite. Available with gluten-free base.

items.name: Simply Salami
items.description: Napoli salami, tangy tomato sauce and mozzarella, stone-baked to crispy perfection. Available with gluten-free base.

items.name: Fully Loaded
items.description: Napoli salami, speck ham, fennel salami and mozzarella on a bold stone-baked base. Available with gluten-free base.

items.name: Nice & Spicy
items.description: 'Nduja, Ventricina, roquito peppers and mozzarella — fiery flavours on a crisp crust. Available with gluten-free base.

items.name: The Garden Club
items.description: Roasted courgettes, caramelised onions, rocket and mozzarella on a rich tomato base. Available with gluten-free base.

items.name: Smoked Chilli Chicken
items.description: Smoky paprika base with chicken, mozzarella and roquito peppers for a spicy-savoury bite. Available with gluten-free base.

items.name: Chicken & Pesto
items.description: Tender chicken, basil pesto and melted mozzarella on a crisp stone-baked crust. Available with gluten-free base.

items.name: Barbecue Chicken
items.description: Sweet and smoky BBQ sauce, chicken, speck ham and mozzarella on a crunchy crust. Available with gluten-free base.

sections.title: Garlic Bread
sections.description: Baked in the same stone oven as our pizzas — golden and crisp on the outside with a soft, garlicky centre.

items.name: Stone-Baked Garlic Bread
items.description: Stone-baked bread brushed with garlic butter, warm and crispy every time.

items.name: Garlic Bread with Mozzarella
items.description: Warm garlic bread crowned with melted mozzarella — a proper shareable.

categories.title: Wraps, Smaller Plates & Sides
categories.description: Easy choices for lighter appetites, casual orders and the table.

sections.title: Wraps & Smaller Plates
sections.description: Quick, satisfying and easy to eat — great for a lighter bite or a snack alongside a drink.

items.name: Chicken Goujon Wrap
items.description: Crispy chicken goujons in a soft wrap with salad and chips — a proper handheld lunch.

items.name: Fish Finger Wrap
items.description: Golden fish fingers in a soft wrap with salad and chips — a pub classic in a new form.

items.name: 4 Chicken Goujons & Chips
items.description: Crispy chicken goujons with chips and your choice of dip — great for sharing or keeping all to yourself.

items.name: 5 Salt & Chilli Squid & Chips
items.description: Salt and chilli squid with chips and your choice of dip — light, crispy and full of flavour.

items.name: 3 Fish Fingers & Chips
items.description: Golden fish fingers with chips and your choice of dip — a proper British favourite.

sections.title: Sides
sections.description: The essentials — perfect for sharing or adding to any plate.

items.name: Chips
items.description: Skin-on chips fried to order and finished with sea salt.

items.name: Chunky Chips
items.description: Thick-cut pub chips with a fluffy centre and crisp exterior.

items.name: Cheesy Chips
items.description: Golden chips under a blanket of melted mature cheddar.

items.name: Sweet Potato Fries
items.description: Lightly spiced sweet potato fries — perfect alongside anything on the menu.

items.name: 6 Onion Rings
items.description: Beer-battered onion rings, golden and crisp — a proper table sharer.

categories.title: Proper Puddings
categories.description: Warm pub puddings and sweet favourites to finish.

items.name: Sticky Toffee Pudding
items.description: Rich sponge in toffee sauce, served warm with custard — the pudding that earns its place every time.

items.name: Apple Crumble
items.description: Warm apple crumble served with custard or ice cream — a proper British pud.

items.name: Chocolate Fudge Brownie
items.description: Warm chocolate brownie with custard or ice cream — gooey, rich and completely worth it.

items.name: Chocolate Fudge Cake
items.description: Hot chocolate fudge cake with cream or custard — the indulgent finish your meal deserves.

items.name: Ice Cream Sundae
items.description: Three scoops of ice cream with chocolate or strawberry sauce — a simple pleasure done right.

categories.title: Hot Drinks
categories.description: A proper cup to finish your visit — made properly and served without the airport price tag.

items.name: Americano
items.description: Double-shot espresso topped with hot water.

items.name: Latte
items.description: Velvety espresso finished with steamed milk.

items.name: Cappuccino
items.description: Equal parts espresso, steamed milk and foam.

items.name: Hot Chocolate
items.description: Creamy cocoa topped with froth.

items.name: Individual Pot of Tea
items.description: Tetley Tea, Decaffeinated, Earl Grey, Green Tea, Green Tea with Lemon, Mint Fusion, Raspberry & Pomegranate.
